Name: A Better Slingshot
Author: Svnsns
Description:
[left][b][size=5]A Better Slingshot 🏹[/size][/b][/left]
Hi. This is my first mod, and it has been written with the help of AI with quality assurance testing (me).
With "A Better Slingshot", you'll be able again to switch on/off the auto fire and/or the infinite ammo function. For now, this mod is written in french but is being translated in English for the next days. 

ABS is working in Stardew Valley 1.6, and has been tested also with Stardew Valley Expanded with several other mods from a +200 mods collection, and I didn't see any issue for now. Keep me in touch if you see something wrong as I will always try to fix it in my free time. ABS is working with GMCM.

I'm open to reviews and new ideas to add to the mod as long as they are benevolent. Any volunteer for translation is greatly appreciated.

~ Seven


[left][b][size=5]Features ⚙️[/size][/b][/left]
• Compatible with the Basic Slingshot, Master Slingshot, and Galaxy Slingshot.
• Optional auto-fire.
• Optional infinite-ammo mode. Keep in mind that it allows you to fire endlessly only if you put a 1 ammo type in the cartridge. If you put all of your rocks in it, it will use all of them first, and once you drop to 1, you'll fire the same ammo over and over again.
• A shooting pace going up accordingly to your fighting skill level.
• All options can be configured through Generic Mod Config Menu.
• Designed for single-player use.
• Compatible with Auto-Stack Bait & Ammo.
• The in-game interface and messages are currently in French.

[left][b][size=5]Important — Infinite Ammo ⚠️[/size][/b][/left]
[size=3]The “Infinite Ammo” option is considered a cheat and is disabled by default.
When enabled, the currently loaded ammo is restored after every shot. This works with regular ammo such as Stone and with Explosive Ammo.[/size]

[left][b][size=5]Requirement 📋[/size][/b][/left]
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or a compatible version.
• SMAPI 4.5.2 or later.

[left][b][size=5]Recommended 👍[/size][/b][/left]
• Generic Mod Config Menu, to configure the mod in-game.

[left][b][size=5]Compatibility 🔩[/size][/b][/left]
• Tested with Auto-Stack Bait & Ammo.
• Tested in a heavily modded SMAPI installation.
• No save data is modified by this mod.
• Works with Stardew Valley Expanded.

[left][b][size=5]Installation 🖥️[/size][/b][/left]
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Download A Better Slingshot.
3. Extract the downloaded ZIP file.
4. Move the A Better Slingshot folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
5. Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.
6. Open Generic Mod Config Menu in-game to configure the available options.
[b]Do not place the ZIP file itself in the Mods folder. Extract it first.[/b]

[left][b][size=5]Uninstallation 📵[/size][/b][/left]
1. Close Stardew Valley.
2. Delete the A Better Slingshot folder from your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
This mod does not modify save data, so no additional cleanup is required.
